getting-started-talking-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-talking-to-ug.text: Ahhh, it no use, I too sad!

options.text: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?

steps.player: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: I love Aga, she so beautiful, she smell so nice, like rotting dead ice wolf!

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: But Arrg that... arrrrrg! He together with Aga and he much stronger than Ug. He rip Ug apart!

steps.player: Who is Aga?

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: She most beautiful troll in world.

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: Ug want to marry Aga, but she with Arrg!

steps.player: Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: You help Ug? You nice, maybe Ug not eat you!

steps.player: Errrr... thanks... I think?
I will go and talk to Aga.
A crying troll who's in love?! This just gets better and better!
Hahahahaha... a crying Troll.
I bet all the other trolls laugh at you!

steps.speaker: Ug
steps.text: Go away, man-thing, leave Ug alone!

steps.player: Hahahahaa!
Well... you're big and hairy?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: Thanks, me very careful about looks!

steps.player: Errr...

options.text: So... how's your... um... love life?

steps.player: (I can't believe I am asking a troll about her love life!!)
So... how's your... um... love life?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It ok, I with Arrg, he very strong and mighty but sometimes...

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: I not know if he love Aga, He say he will show he love by bringing me flower Trollweiss.

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It a very rare, beautiful flower, it very special!

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: It grow somewhere in these mountains.

steps.player: (Maybe trolls DO have a romantic streak!)
And Arrg said he would get you the flower?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: He very strong, if he love Aga he will get Trollweiss.

options.text: So... what do you think about Ug?

steps.player: So... what do you think about Ug?

steps.speaker: Aga
steps.text: Who?

steps.player: You know that wimpy, crying... nevermind.
Errr... I've got to go.

getting-started-talking-to-aga-again.speaker: Aga
getting-started-talking-to-aga-again.text: Aga can't wait for Trollweiss. Arrg will show his love!

options.text: Well, got to go... see you.

steps.player: Errr... I've got to go.

options.text: So... what do you think about Ug?

getting-started-talking-to-arrg.player: Ehh, Excuse me... Mr. Troll, sir,

options.text: How did you grow so big and strong?

steps.player: How did you grow so big and strong?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Get away from Arrg, puny man-maggot. Or you lunch!

options.text: Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?

steps.player: Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Girlfriend? Which one?

steps.player: Errr... Aga.

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Yes, she good cook and wash but talk too many. Arrg strong troll, Arrg mighty troll, Arrg have many girlfriends!

steps.player: (What a jerk!)
Yes, yes, you're great, but what about the Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: I no know, I just say to make Aga shut up!

steps.player: So you don't actually know where to find the Trollweiss?
Great...
I've got to go.

getting-started-returning-to-ug.player: Yes, she said that she really wants a certain flower! Trollweiss, I think she called it.

getting-started-returning-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-returning-to-ug.text: Oh no! Then Ug no chance, Trollweiss not found in years!

getting-started-returning-to-ug.player: Don't worry I'll find it for you!

getting-started-returning-to-ug.speaker: Ug
getting-started-returning-to-ug.text: You no chance, Ug no chance, need someone who live whole life in mountains. Ug no know anyone like that...

options.text: Can I buy some Climbing boots?
How did you find out about the secret way?
Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?

steps.player: Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: It has been a long time since someone has asked me about Trollweiss.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: In the old days Trollweiss could be found all over the mountains, but recently it has been disappearing!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: There is one place, where I am sure it still grows, but it is impossible to get to.

steps.player: Nothing's impossible, if you put your mind to it!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Ahhh, the youth of today. So sure of their prowess. But who am I to stop you from walking into your doom, if that is what you wish to do!

steps.player: Spare me with the lectures and tell me where to find this flower!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Well, you will need to enter the domain of the ice trolls! This is an area full of wicked beasts and biting cold. From there you will find a way down a slope to a plateau where the Trollweiss grows.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: It used to be easy to get to this plateau, but it is now snowed over and virtually inaccessible. That's global warming for you!

steps.player: There must be a way to get there.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: There is maybe one thing...

steps.player: Go on.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: If you could make some sort of sled, you could probably get down there but I don't know where that would lead you, as you will not be able to go up the mountain again.

options.text: That doesn't sound like a very good idea to me!

steps.player: That doesn't sound like a very good idea to me!

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Pah, who are you to talk? Without me you would never have found the secret path to the plateau!!

options.text: What would I need to make such a sled?

steps.player: What would I need to make such a sled?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Well, I'm no expert. Maybe you should speak to someone who knows more about such technical stuff.

steps.player: Like who?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Why don't you ask Dunstan. He's always helped me with my spiked boots.

steps.player: Thank you very much for the information.
I've got to go.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: See you later

steps.player: Hi!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Hi! Did you want something?

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?

steps.player: I need a sled!!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Haha, very funny! Aren't you a bit old for rolling around in the snow?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: So why do you need a sled then?

steps.player: I need the sled to get to a certain location in the mountains.
No.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Hahahaha.

steps.player: No, I actually still like rolling around in the snow.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, I guess some of us never grow up!

steps.player: I need the sled to get to a certain location in the mountains.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, since you've helped my family out a couple of times, I'd be glad to build a sled for you.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Yeah, that should do it. I will need some yew or maple logs, a bar of iron and some rope.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: I should have my designs ready by the time you have brought me all the materials.

options.text: Is it OK if I use your anvil?

steps.player: Nothing, thanks.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Have you got all the materials for the sled yet?

steps.player: No, I haven't got everything yet.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, unfortunately I can't make the sled without all the materials.

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
How is your son getting on?
Is it OK if I use your anvil?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Have you got all the materials for the sled yet?

steps.player: Yes, I have all the materials for the sled.

steps.text: Dunstan takes the materials and some of his tools and starts making a sled. After a while Dunstan hands you a finished sled.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Well, here's the sled but it will need to be waxed. The wax will need to both protect the sled as well as smoothen it.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Maybe if you mix some wax with a bit of swamp tar it will achieve the desired effect. You'll also need something to store the wax in... like a cake tin.

options.text: Where can I get wax from?

steps.player: Where can I get wax from?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: I don't know. I'm a smith! But maybe you should look for some bees.

options.text: Where can I get swamp tar from?

steps.player: Where can I get swamp tar from?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: The swamp of course! It's south of Lumbridge.

steps.player: What else do I need?

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: You will also need a cake tin to store the wax in.

options.condition: After selecting one of the other options:

steps.player: See you!

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Thank you, come again.

steps.speaker: Dunstan
steps.text: Hello again.

options.text: Where can I get wax from?
Where can I get swamp tar from?

finding-the-flowers-waxing-the-sled.text: You wax the slex. You're now ready to go.

finding-the-flowers-sledding-crashing.player: And I thought snow was soft...
Although it was a little softer than the rock I hit.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.player: Yes, I've got it right here.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.text: But me too scared to give Trollweiss to Aga because Arrg will eat Ug for breakfast.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.player: What? So I have to get rid of Arrg as well? After all this trouble I should be the one getting the girl...

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.text: You no touch Aga. Ug kill you.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.player: Ok, I'll tell Arrg you said that. Shall I tell him to meet you here?

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.text: No, no, no, wait! Ug just joke, oh great man-legend. Ug puny, you strong.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug.player: I suppose I am a bit of a legend. Ok I'll do it!

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-before-def.player: No, not yet. Something like this requires careful planning.

returning-to-ug-using-trollweiss-on-aga.text: That's probably not a good idea...

returning-to-ug-challenging-argg.player: Ehh, Excuse me... Mr. Troll, sir,

options.text: I am here to kill you!

steps.player: I am here to kill you!

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: Very good, Arrg was getting hungry.

steps.player: But not in front of the lady, let's take it outside.

steps.text: The player and Arrg are transported to the troll arena.

steps.player: Aga deserves better than you.

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: What you mean? Arrg strong troll, Arrg mighty troll. Every troll woman want Arrg.

steps.player: But you don't love her!

steps.speaker: Arrg
steps.text: This concept of 'love' confuses and infuriates Arrg.

steps.player: Looks like I'm going to have to teach you a lesson in 'love'.
But not in front of the lady, let's take it outside.

steps.text: The player and Arrg are transported to the troll arena.

steps.player: I've got to go.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-arrg-after-de.speaker: Arrg
returning-to-ug-talking-to-arrg-after-de.text: Oh mighty man-warrior, please no hurt Arrg.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.text: You very strong and nice. Take pretty rocks as thanks.

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.player: Thanks, Ug. So, now you can go and speak to Aga!
Has anyone ever told you that you are a useless troll? My grandmother has more guts than you and she doesn't even have her teeth anymore!

returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.speaker: Ug
returning-to-ug-talking-to-ug-after-defe.text: Whaaat? Man-thing want to die? Ug no scared of you or your grandmother! Ug show you. Ug go to Aga now.
